findings.finding: SVRN's value is a levered claim on NEAR: it rose +669% in a month against NEAR's +148% in 30 days, so most of the run was premium expansion. That premium has now fallen two sessions running (-25.8% on 09-30, -20.1% to the screen on 10-01) and the window carries both NEAR's overnight path and further exits by momentum holders.
findings.mechanism_in_window: NEAR trades 24/7, so its path between today's close and tomorrow's close sets SVRN's next-session move at high beta. Momentum holders from the 20-day +440% run have not finished exiting: the second -20% day followed the first.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline own comparable falls (n=24): median next close -6.07%, 41.7% up, mean +0.7%. The 2025-08-21/22 back-to-back falls continued (-19.75%, -5.85%); the 2026-09-30 fall continued (-20.09% to the screen). 2025-10-17, 2026-03-18 and 2026-06-05 bounced +23 to +26%.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices two days of unwind but not a third. If the market thought the premium was fully gone, the intraday leg (-8.7% after a -12.5% gap) would have stalled rather than extended through the session.
findings.independence: CoinGape puts NEAR's 30-day gain at 148% before the exploit and lists support at $4.50 and $4.00: https://coingape.com/markets/whats-next-for-near-protocol-price-after-3-8m-near-intents-hack/

findings.finding: The NEAR Intents exploit that triggered the drop is patched. NEAR Intents has promised full reimbursement, and suspended deposits and withdrawals on 11 networks were expected back within about 12 hours, so service restoration lands inside the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The restoration is timed for about 12 hours after the 2026-10-01 halt, so it lands overnight or by the 2026-10-02 session.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior NEAR-protocol security incident is in this name's baseline. Its NEAR-led moves are high beta: +669% against NEAR's +148% over the month.
findings.why_not_priced: The patch and the reimbursement pledge were public by 10:18 ET and are mostly priced. What is not in the close is confirmation that services are actually back and losses actually covered. If that were priced, NEAR would have recovered toward its pre-exploit level instead of holding near $4.9.
findings.independence: NewsBytes, separately, reports the full-reimbursement pledge: https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/business/near-intents-hacked-for-38-million-and-promises-full-reimbursement/tldr

findings.finding: The issuer has no ready dilution route tonight. The ATM (Clear Street/Cohen, up to $250M) sat on F-3 333-273073, effective 2023-07-14, and EDGAR shows no FY2025 20-F filed (Nasdaq 5250(c)(1) notice of 2026-05-19, cure by 2026-10-27). There is no new primary shelf and no 424B in 2026 filings.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The commonest second shoe for a fallen small cap is an ATM draw or an overnight registered direct. Neither can price before the 2026-10-02 close without an effective shelf and current annual reports, and the submissions feed shows no filing after 2026-08-27.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name ran an ATM program from 2025-10-29 under the same shelf, so it has used the route before. That makes its absence now informative.
findings.why_not_priced: The cross-sectional drift for fallers partly reflects offerings that land overnight. This name cannot do that tonight, which the tape cannot see because it does not read the shelf status. If it were priced, SVRN would trade like a capped-supply asset near NAV rather than continuing a -2.4%-type volume-driven drift. That the shelf is unusable is partly my legal inference (the three-year shelf life and F-3 eligibility), so this finding carries little weight.
findings.independence: Nasdaq late-20-F notice 6-K, 2026-05-22: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1869467/000091957426003683/d12167336_ex99-1.htm ; EDGAR 20-F list showing the last 20-F on 2025-04-15: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=1869467&type=20-F&dateb=&owner=include&count=40

outside_window.finding: Nasdaq 5250(c)(1) exception for the unfiled FY2025 20-F expires 2026-10-27. Filing would cure it and restore shelf access; missing it brings a delisting determination.

At $39.94, roughly 5.3-5.6M fully diluted shares (1,875,816 common as of 2026-07-31 plus ~3.4-3.7M post-split pre-funded warrants from the 75.2M pre-split issued) puts SVRN near 0.8x NAV against 55.5M NEAR at ~$4.9. That is the company's stated buyback trigger, with $7.3M of authorisation left as of April. The warrant count is my estimate, and no buyback activity is dated inside the window.

102.96M pre-split shares (~5.15M post-split, NEAR Foundation 71.6%) are on a resale F-3. With no current 20-F the prospectus and Rule 144 current-information route are likely impaired until filing. The one-year holding period on the 2025-10-28 PIPE passes 2026-10-28, which frees non-affiliate supply.
